items.markdown:
![How To Make French Press Coffee (Step-by-Step Guide) | The Kitchn](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/10082000-2302-0066-0000-f82732af49c8:4)
To use a French press, `add 2 tablespoons (10 grams) of coarse coffee grounds per 6 ounces (180 ml) of water, pour in water heated to 195–205°F (90–96°C), steep for 4 minutes, and slowly press the plunger down`.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2ziSri3o8Y8&t=1)[[2]](https://athome.starbucks.com/brewing-guide/how-brew-coffee-press)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/y9CI5Tddb_I)

### Step-by-Step Instructions

- **Preheat the press:** Rinse the empty carafe with hot water to warm it up, then dump the water out.[[1]](https://athome.starbucks.com/brewing-guide/how-brew-coffee-press)
- **Add coffee:** Measure out coarse-ground coffee (similar in texture to coarse sea salt or breadcrumbs). Use roughly 2 tablespoons (10g) per cup of water.[[1]](https://www.tiktok.com/@cc.campbell/video/6940346284796644614?lang=en-GB)[[2]](https://athome.starbucks.com/brewing-guide/how-brew-coffee-press)
- **Bloom the grounds:** Pour in just enough hot water (about 195–205°F) to wet the grounds and let it sit for 30 to 60 seconds so trapped gases can escape.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5x9mTJKcpp4&t=1)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YIKr2EMkm48&t=33)[[3]](https://athome.starbucks.com/brewing-guide/how-brew-coffee-press)
- **Fill and stir:** Pour in the rest of the hot water up to about an inch from the rim, give it a gentle stir, and place the lid on top without pressing down.[[1]](https://www.illy.com/en-us/coffee/coffee-preparation/how-to-use-a-french-press)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/y9CI5Tddb_I)
- **Steep:** Let the coffee brew undisturbed for **4 minutes** (or up to 5 minutes for lighter roasts).[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/y9CI5Tddb_I)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2ziSri3o8Y8&t=1)
- **Plunge and pour:** Push the plunger down slowly with steady, even pressure. Pour the coffee out immediately into your mug so it doesn't turn bitter from sitting on the grounds.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YIKr2EMkm48&t=33)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2ziSri3o8Y8&t=1)[[3]](https://www.illy.com/en-us/coffee/coffee-preparation/how-to-use-a-french-press)
